meta_description: GraveCare Liverpool creates bespoke memorials and headstones with care and respect. Expert craftsmanship for lasting tributes. Call 07547 924644 today.
hero_subhead: Beautifully crafted memorials and headstones that reflect a life well lived. Personalised design with sensitivity and skill.
services_subhead: From traditional headstones to bespoke cremation plaques, we craft enduring tributes tailored to your loved one's memory.

services.title: Bespoke Headstones
services.desc: Custom-designed memorials in granite, marble or slate, with lettering and imagery that capture a life's story. We handle full installation and positioning to cemetery standards.

services.title: Cremation Plaques & Tablets
services.desc: Elegant brass or stone plaques for garden of remembrance sites. Sized to fit your chosen location, with personalised engraving in your preferred style and wording.

services.title: Kerbsets & Edgings
services.desc: Complete granite or marble borders that frame and protect a burial plot. Durable and refined, with or without inscribed detail.

services.title: Memorial Benches & Seats
services.desc: Lasting tribute pieces for gardens, parks or cemeteries. Choose stone or wood, with engraved plaques that honour memory and invite quiet reflection.

services.title: Lettering & Inscription Services
services.desc: Expert engraving of names, dates and personal messages on existing or new memorials. Crisp, deep cut work that stands the test of time.

services.title: Restoration & Cleaning
services.desc: Professional restoration of weathered memorials, including careful cleaning, minor repairs and re-gilding of lettering. Brings old tributes back to life.

about_pullquote: Every memorial tells a story. We listen and create with care and skill.
about_para_1: GraveCare Liverpool has been crafting memorials for families and communities across Merseyside for over two decades. Founded on the belief that a memorial should honour the individual—their passions, values and character—we take time to understand your vision. Each piece is handcrafted using quality materials and traditional techniques.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on sensitivity, attention to detail and reliability. Families choose us because we respect the weight of the moment, answer your questions honestly, and deliver memorials that endure. From initial design through installation, we're with you every step.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Families Say About GraveCare

reviews.text: We were devastated after losing Mum, and John at GraveCare made the whole process straightforward and dignified. The headstone is absolutely beautiful—exactly what we wanted. He listened to every detail and didn't rush us. Can't recommend enough.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Had our son's memorial restored after ten years of weather. They cleaned it up, re-gilded the lettering, and it looks brand new. Professional, respectful, and a fair price. Thank you.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Dad wanted something personal and quirky—a memorial that showed his sense of humour. John brought that vision to life perfectly. The craftsmanship is outstanding. We visit often and always smile.
reviews.author: Claire M.
